title: Renting a Home

expressions.example: Is the apartment furnished or unfurnished?
When is the rent due each month?

expressions.expr: We need to sign the lease
expressions.example: We need to sign the lease this week.

expressions.expr: The landlord will do an inspection
expressions.example: The landlord will do an inspection before we move out.

sentences: If the rent is too high, I will look for another apartment.
If we sign the lease today, we will move in next week.
If the apartment is furnished, the rent will be higher.
If you damage something, you will lose your deposit.
If the landlord agrees, we will renew the contract.
If the utilities aren't included, we will pay separately.
If the inspection goes well, we will get our deposit back.
If I find a roommate, I will save money on rent.

grammar.title: Making Decisions About Renting — First Conditional
rules: First conditional: If + present simple, will + infinitivo, para condições reais e futuras: If the rent is high, I will look elsewhere.
Usado para prever consequências de decisões sobre aluguel, contratos e vistorias.
A ordem das orações pode ser invertida: I will move in if the lease is signed.
"Will" pode ser substituído por "can/might" para indicar possibilidade em vez de certeza.

rows: If the rent is high, I will move.
If it rains, I might stay in.
I will move in if the lease is signed.
I won't sign unless it's furnished.
